actions.text:
Hi Marcus — thank you for reaching out and for the kind words about my React work. I’m interested in this dashboard project; the scope you outlined (real-time visualizations, REST API integration, auth/role-based access, responsive design, and dark mode) fits well with my experience. Your budget and 4-week timeline are reasonable — I can commit to starting next month, and I estimate the project would land near the top of your stated range depending on final requirements.

A few quick questions so I can prepare a detailed proposal: 1) Do you have existing data schemas/endpoints for the real-time streams or would I be building adapters? 2) How many distinct user roles and permission levels do you expect? 3) Any preference on charting libraries beyond D3 (e.g., Recharts, Vega, or commercial components)? 4) Preferred time for a 30–45 minute call to align on requirements (I’m generally available mornings CST next week).

If that works, I can draft a short proposal with milestones and a firm quote and we can schedule a call to finalize. Thanks — looking forward to hearing more.

Best,
Jordan Mitchell
ML Engineer — TechCorp Inc.
jordan.mitchell@email.com
